title: 2" Openings Lack Gripper Coating; Poor Choice for Tightly Packed Closet
text:
2" Openings Lack Gripper Coating; Poor Choice for Tightly Packed Closet. This INTERDESIGN REMY SCARF HANGER CLOSET ORGANIZER (No Snag) will hold scarves, and any other long and narrow clothing items that can be threaded through the holes. It's definitely a "no snag" organizer, because the openings are surrounded by smooth plastic. The openings are NOT coated with rubberized material (to lightly grip the items and prevent slipping off as the organizer is moved along the closet rod).

To mininize sliding off, the items should be added carefully with the midpoints at the organizer holes (so that the weight of each item is balanced on both sides). When the organizer is fully loaded, the items overlap, so it's easy to pull off more than one item at a time.

The openings are 2" across--wider items will need to be folded lengthwise. This type of organizer doesn't work well in a tightly packed closet, because the items hung on it will take up space on both sides. Also, you need some extra space to add and remove items.

Because of the lack of gripper material, I rate this scarf hanger at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).
